description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for a Spring Boot application, providing basic utility endpoints such as welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic utility endpoints for the Notes App backend, including welcome, documentation redirect, health check, and info endpoints.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message when the root endpoint '/' is accessed.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects incoming requests from '/docs' to the Swagger UI at '/swagger-ui.html' while preserving the request's original scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a health check endpoint that returns 'OK' indicating the application is running.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns basic information about the application.
